title: ThalamicTrajectoryV2
description: Strict publication contract for newly generated training trajectories. Requires top-level id, state.sim_or_real enum, reward_components.total finite, and meta.round integer >=1. Generative models must satisfy this schema exactly.

id.description: Required globally unique stable string record identifier. Must be non-empty.

sim_or_real.description: Required provenance enum: exactly 'designed', 'simulated', or 'hil'. Never 'real' or 'unknown'.

state.description: Rich observable environment; requires canonical provenance sim_or_real.

total.description: Required finite total; must be a finite number (no NaN/Infinity) equal to sum of finite numeric components excluding bookkeeping keys, reconciled within 1e-6.

reward_components.description: Decomposed reward with required finite total.

round.description: Required factory round number. Must be an integer >=1 (boolean not allowed).
